title: 既有artifact driver補齊同一FINAL封存bytes合法回復路徑

implementation_summary.scripts/dev_release_artifacts.py: Extracted save_image helper from capture_images so candidate image admission persists byte-verified, fsynced, lease-checked archives identically to baseline. Added restore-final to FAILURE_STAGES.
implementation_summary.scripts/dev_candidate_receipt.py: Added SCHEMA_V2 (pantheon.dev-candidate-image-admission.v2) validating nested candidate_bundle_sha256 digest while preserving 5-field outer wrapper contract; exported candidate_bundle_sha256 in finalize.
implementation_summary.scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh: Added --artifact-restore-final CLI option; added PANTHEON_DEV_ARTIFACT_TARGET to SSH command prefix; validated mandatory FE_MANIFEST_SHA256 and FE_DIST_SHA256 non-zero 64-hex hashes in validate_artifact_restore_request when target is final; forwarded FE digest variables across SSH; updated run_dev_artifact_driver to fail closed if FE digests missing and pass mandatory --fe-manifest-sha256 and --fe-dist-sha256 for restore-final; dispatched restore-final in external restore mode when target is final.
implementation_summary.scripts/dev_release_artifact_driver.py: Switched CANDIDATE_SCHEMA to v2; in _seal_candidate, persisted archives and computed candidate_bundle_sha256 before constructing receipt, cryptographically binding candidate bundle into the externally sealed receipt digest; in _load_candidate, verified bundle against receipt[candidate_bundle_sha256] and failed closed on unsealed v1 receipts; in restore-final, validated candidate frontend against live capture and enforced fail-closed mandatory caller FE digests (--fe-manifest-sha256, --fe-dist-sha256, --fe-target); rejected mutated FE even if on-disk candidate-frontend.json seal is rewritten; rejected tampered archives even with rewritten adjacent checksums.
implementation_summary.scripts/test_dev_release_artifacts.py: Added test_save_image_persists_archive_and_rejects_empty_or_differing_overwrite verifying idempotency and rejection of empty/tampered archives.
implementation_summary.docs/deployment/dev-exact-artifact-rollb: Documented step 8 for returning to the same admitted final sealed candidate bytes.

explicit_unaccepted_gaps.worker_boundary: Worker is strictly SOURCEONLY with no VM, provider, Root, control, capital, or live operator execution permissions.
explicit_unaccepted_gaps.live_roundtrip: Live VM execution of rollback drill followed by return to final sealed bytes was NOT performed; live roundtrip remains an unexecuted live coordinator obligation.
explicit_unaccepted_gaps.data_preservation_claims: Zero acknowledged data loss (PG/WAL/SHM) on hosted dev VM must be proven by live coordinator post-drill database readback, not by code-level or test fixture claims.
explicit_unaccepted_gaps.frontend_live_symlink: Frontend hosted symlink switch and rollback remain live FE/controller-owned operations on the dev VM.
